name: Market Creators Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1991, Market Creators Ltd is primarily in the broking business[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
MCL operates primarily in direct equity broking, 
trading, and distribution of financial products. It 
offers immediate trading opportunities through 
brokerage, as well as strategic investment
through the product distribution for over 
15,000 investors through 105 outlets,
 in 18 cities.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 9.92% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 1.07% over last 3 years.
Working capital days have increased from 26.8 days to 109 days
